W.note: Thorough and well-tested (contrast readouts, disabled, focus ring, reduced motion, hover gated to fine pointers) with a soft settle glow on the dark stage, but the page is mostly a designer-facing lab and the hover reads as a gentle fade more than a dream.

X.note: Attractive moodboard, but the hover is a sheen band sweeping across a Send button plus an infinitely looping blurred aura, which reads as shiny rather than ethereal and costs paint on every frame while hovered.

Y.note: Strongest complete website hero: a legible dark stage with a glow and halo that rise on a settle curve, a distinct slower exit curve, a glass secondary, a focus ring, disabled and reduced-motion handling, and a clear affordance, though the glow is restrained.

Z.note: Most dreamlike hover in the frames, with a rose-violet gradient shift, sheen and text glow that feel luminous, but it animates box-shadow, background-position and letter-spacing, which is paint- and layout-heavy and slower to answer than the rest.
